messages:
nina_cs: Heads-up - HelioLabs saw 503s hitting eu-west during a 700rps demo. They asked for an emergency regional QPS bump + allowlist for CDN partner CloudSpan. Also worried about renewal in 14 days; want a follow-up enablement session after demo.

hamid_ops: On it. Do we have the CDN IP blocks and how long they want the bump?

nina_cs: IPs: 203.0.113.0/24 and 2001:db8:1234::/48. Request: eu-west -> 1100 qps for 36h. Demo tomorrow 09:30 UTC.

jasper_sre: I'll provision a temporary ingress allowlist + rate window with TTL and auto-revoke. Plan: pin route to low-latency model family and run KV warm-up 20m before demo.

deploy-bot: Deployment 2026-03-23_09:00 started by jasper_sre; created route eu-west-helio-burst-1742100001

hamid_ops: jasper - please apply now and DM the revocation time so I can tell the AM.

jasper_sre: Done. API call used (internal): curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/internal/provision -d '{"cidrs":["203.0.113.0/24","2001:db8:1234::/48"],"regions":{"eu-west":1100},"ttl":129600}'

jasper_sre: Autorevoke set for 36h (UTC epoch 1742233601). Audit log: /internal/logs/provision/1742100001.txt

ori_account: Noted. I logged a renewal risk and scheduled a post-demo 1:1 and a 7-day usage check. We'll collect feedback on latency and peering.

nina_cs: Thanks team :raised_hands: I'll send the prep notes to HelioLabs and request the feedback form after demo.
